resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service list all give a 40-foot pole L-4 tower. A Montana archive caption calls Jerry Johnson a 30-foot tower, but says only that the photograph is probably of this lookout. The story uses 40 feet and mentions the caption.

firelookout.com and the Forest Service list say 11 miles west of the Powell ranger station. A May 1934 Missoulian item, as quoted on Forest Lookouts, says 15 1/2 miles down the Lochsa River from Powell. The sources were not reconciled, so the story gives both.

Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site drive-up. The 1934 newspaper item describes pack strings bringing material in that year. These describe different times and the story reports both without ranking them.

notes_for_editor: Core dates (built 1934, destroyed 1972) and the 40-foot L-4 design agree across three sources. The distance from Powell and the 30-foot caption in source 5 conflict and are reported, not resolved. The photo caption in source 5 is hedged; I did not treat it as firm evidence of this lookout's location or of current drive access. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so no staffing fact is recorded. A Montana History Portal audio record (node 65775) describes fires of 1929 and 1934 near the Jerry Johnson trail; it does not describe the lookout, so it is not used. The Montana photo may be a candidate for a photo entry, but I did not have a direct image URL and its copyright status is 'In Copyright', so none is recorded. Land ownership and current access rules were not found.
